scripts.install-bin: rm -rf dist && bun build src/main.ts --compile --define "process.env.PHANTOM_ADMIN='1'" --outfile dist/phantom && mv dist/phantom ~/.local/bin/phantom
scripts.build-user-bin: rm -rf dist && bun build src/main.ts --compile --define "process.env.PHANTOM_ADMIN='0'" --outfile dist/phantom
